summary_en: This Phase Ib/II study is testing AMO959 together with lutetium (177Lu) vipivotide tetraxetan (AAA617) and an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) in adults with PSMA-positive metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer. Dosing differs by arm, but most arms give AAA617 on day 1 of each 6-week cycle, with AMO959 twice daily on days 2 to 15, for a maximum of 6 cycles. The primary outcome is not stated; Phase Ib assesses safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics, and Phase II assesses preliminary efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase Ib/II evalúa AMO959 junto con lutecio (177Lu) vipivotida tetraxetán (AAA617) y un inhibidor de la vía del receptor de andrógenos (ARPI) en adultos con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración con PSMA positivo. Los esquemas de dosis varían según el brazo, pero la mayoría de los brazos administra AAA617 el día 1 de cada ciclo de 6 semanas, con AMO959 dos veces al día los días 2 a 15, por un máximo de 6 ciclos. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; la fase Ib evalúa seguridad, tolerabilidad y farmacocinética, y la fase II evalúa la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Castrate testosterone level and/or use of androgen deprivation therapy.
Progression on one prior ARPI in an earlier setting, by PSA, soft-tissue or bone criteria.
not_for: Prostate cancer histology other than adenocarcinoma, such as neuroendocrine or intraductal subtype.
Prior radioligand therapy or prior PSMA-targeted agents.
Prostate radiation with curative intent or other systemic anticancer treatment within 28 days of enrollment or randomization.
Other investigational agents within 28 days before first study dose.
Serious medical conditions that may interfere with study procedures or follow-up, or CNS metastases without required treatment or neurologic stability.
